comments: Input facts: ego is the car responder; agent1 is the car initiator; the group requires a turn between trafficways with one actor operating against intended travel. Chosen assumptions: Agent1 initiates a right turn into a different trafficway. Ego approaches against the receiving lane direction and responds to proximity by sustained braking. A four-way intersection is used. Agent1 starts on an incoming lane and follows its chosen turn into ego's lane; ego is already on that turn's end lane. The lateral position is resolved using the chosen turn rather than a straight crossing. No adjacent lane is needed; no denotes no required adjacent lane. Initial separation is 12-35 m. Ego starts at 5-8 m/s; agent1 targets 5-7 m/s. Proximity response thresholds, when used, are 10-16 m. Conflict opportunity is intended; a collision is not required.
